relations.statement: Ada asked Nessa to plan the next season with her rather than simply fill a vacant lane.

hooks.statement: The stencil instructions finally explained the crescent notch: it positioned the timing grid.
The four NEXT SERIES boxes were still empty when Ada filed the card; nobody knew which series they meant.
Inside the knot Imani found a tiny sewn number, 41, but no team name and no explanation.
